content: PyTorch MPS caveats: no float64 (use float32); set PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1 for unimplemented ops (CPU fallback, slower, occasionally unreliable e.g. some Conv1d). Historical silent kernel bugs (addcmul_/addcdiv_ on non-contiguous outputs affecting Adam) — fixed in recent versions/macOS 15+. Weak FP16/AMP benefit vs CUDA (no tensor cores). Official ref: docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/notes/mps.html
